full_judgment: 48. Under section 83(3) of the Companies Act every meeting of the Directors in respect of the proceedings whereof minutes have been so made shall be deemed to have been duly called and hold and all proceedings had thereat to have been duly bad until the contrary is proved. The burden of proof is upon the said respondents. Until the said burden is discharged the said respondents cannot be heard to say that the minutes of the proceedings of the Board of Directors were wrong Prima facie they were parties to the decision to sell the shares of Taiwa to Sigma International Inc. and they cannot be given credence at this stage if they blow hot and cold at the same time.
